notes.title: Launch Update
notes.notes: This update contains certain quality of life improvements, such as glyphs for controller controls and an adjustment to in-game audio

notes.title: Controller fix
notes.notes:
It was a great day, until I tried to play the game with the controller instead of the keyboard, so everything went...BOOM!!!

After 2 intense days of experiments, our best men come with what they believe is a solution.
